🚨 CVE-2026-122221
The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'section_title_tag' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Binance confirmed a security incident and suspended withdrawals on multiple networks after users reported funds draining from its wallets.

Crypto trackers estimate between $2 billion and $5.7 billion was pulled from Binance hot wallets, with Circle and Tether freezing roughly $800 million and $1.56 billion in stablecoins tied to the theft.

Apple Patches Exploited CoreGraphics Zero-Day on Older iPhones

Apple patched a CoreGraphics zero-day, tracked as CVE-2026-86950, with iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 updates for older devices released October 26, 2026.

The out-of-bounds write flaw lets a crafted file trigger code execution on devices including the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, and seventh-generation iPad.

Apple said the flaw may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals running iOS versions before iOS 27.

Capcom disclosed that unauthorized access to its CAPCOM ID account service exposed 11,774,247 records worldwide.

Attackers also changed passwords on 196 accounts without permission, though Capcom says no credit card information was affected.

Capcom has reported the breach to Japanese police and the national privacy regulator as its investigation continues.

Hackers Exploit Chained Plex Flaws to Deploy Cryptominer Malware

Security researchers confirmed active exploitation of a four-bug chain called Plex2Shell against exposed Plex Media Server honeypots.

The chain links a server-side request forgery flaw with an unsigned codec-loading bug to reach unauthenticated code execution on Linux and Windows hosts.

Attackers deployed XMRig cryptominers and proxyware on compromised Docker and NAS deployments running outdated builds.

Plex fixed the flaws in a September update, so administrators on unpatched or exposed servers should update now.

@Cyber_Security_Channel

Senator Warns Federal Sites Expose Whistleblowers to Hackers

Sen. Ron Wyden warned that hundreds of federal websites fail to encrypt visitor connection data, exposing whistleblowers, crime tipsters, and crisis-support callers to hackers and foreign spies.

His office found over 350 sites, including an FBI tip line and a VA suicide-prevention hotline, that still lack Encrypted Client Hello protections despite the technology being available.

Wyden urged CISA and the White House budget office to make ECH mandatory for all public federal websites and cloud vendors.

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/WJolmCy

Mit einer Sammelklage fordert er Rückzahlungen an geschädigte Verbraucher:innen. Betroffene können sich für die Klage beim Bundesamt für Justiz (BfJ) anmelden.

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/g45dbKP

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/t3ErflT

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/INeWn96

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/1pxnLO8

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/42IPr5u

via Aktuelle Meldungen https://ift.tt/rKbmBlu
